bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; capital investment; amending a previous appropriation for improvements along marked Trunk Highway 65 in Anoka County; amending Laws 2023, chapter 68, article 2, section 2, subdivision 4, as amended.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Laws 2023, chapter 68, article 2, section 2, subdivision 4, as amended by Laws 2024, chapter 104, article 1, section 102, is amended to read:

Subd. 4.
Trunk Highway 65; Anoka County

68,750,000

This appropriation is for predesign, right-of-way acquisition, design, engineering, and construction of intersection improvements along Trunk Highway 65 at 99th Avenue Northeast; 105th Avenue Northeast; Anoka County State-Aid Highway 12; 109th Avenue Northeast; 117th Avenue Northeast; [+Anoka County State-Aid Highway 116; +]and the associated frontage roads and backage roads within the trunk highway system.

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
